sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机地想要掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“简·多伊”（无名氏）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字：艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认了她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“案件档案呈现”系列的新作，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: The story features three characters.
sentences.zh: 这个故事里有三个角色。

sentences.en: A mother, her daughter, and the daughter's suitor.
sentences.zh: 一位母亲、她的女儿，以及女儿的追求者。

sentences.en: The daughter's suitor lived deep inside a very dark cave.
sentences.zh: 女儿的追求者住在一个非常黑暗的洞穴深处。

sentences.en: One day, the daughter asked her mother if she could visit this man.
sentences.zh: 有一天，女儿问母亲是否可以去探望这个男人。

sentences.en: The mother had concerns, but didn't want to stand in the way of her daughter's happiness.
sentences.zh: 母亲心存顾虑，但不想阻碍女儿的幸福。

sentences.en: So, she pulled a thread out from the edge of her skirt, and told her daughter to hold on to it as she made her way into the cave.
sentences.zh: 于是，她从裙边抽出一根线，告诉女儿在进入洞穴时一定要紧紧攥住它。

sentences.en: If, for whatever reason, she felt in danger, all she needed to do was tug on the thread.
sentences.zh: 如果因为任何原因感到危险，她只需要拉一下那根线。

sentences.en: Her mother would then pull her away from harm.
sentences.zh: 母亲就会把她从危险中拉出来。

sentences.en: Sonia Ryan was 20 years old when she gave birth to her daughter, Carly.
sentences.zh: 索尼娅·瑞安在20岁时生下了女儿卡莉。

sentences.en: Being a young, single mother was not without struggles.
sentences.zh: 作为一名年轻的单身母亲，生活并非没有挣扎。

sentences.en: But in a unique and special way, Sonia felt Carly saved her life.
sentences.zh: 但索尼娅觉得，卡莉以一种独特而特别的方式拯救了她的生命。

sentences.en: She drew strength knowing her baby girl needed her.
sentences.zh: 知道女儿需要自己，这让她获得了力量。

sentences.en: No matter how hard things got, Carly gave Sonia reason and purpose to go on.
sentences.zh: 无论生活多么艰难，卡莉都给了索尼娅继续前行的理由和目标。

sentences.en: This bond between mother and daughter evolved as Carly grew older, but never broke, only strengthened.
sentences.zh: 母女之间的这种纽带随着卡莉的长大而演变，但从未断裂，反而愈发坚固。

sentences.en: It was mirrored quite literally in the striking resemblance the pair bore to one another.
sentences.zh: 这一点在两人惊人的相似之处中得到了最直观的体现。

sentences.en: It was often remarked that they looked more like sisters, with matching porcelain skin, chestnut hair, deep brown eyes, and a shared sense of style and interests.
sentences.zh: 人们常说她们看起来更像姐妹，有着同样的瓷白肌肤、栗色头发、深棕色眼睛，以及相似的品味和兴趣。

sentences.en: As she entered adolescence, Carly experienced her own struggles.
sentences.zh: 进入青春期后，卡莉也经历了自己的挣扎。

sentences.en: Guiding her along was her mother's unconditional love and wisdom.
sentences.zh: 母亲无条件的爱与智慧一直指引着她。

sentences.en: Carly told her mum everything.
sentences.zh: 卡莉什么都跟妈妈说。

sentences.en: The two shared a very open and honest friendship.
sentences.zh: 两人分享着一种非常坦诚的友谊。

sentences.en: Sonia supported Carly whilst giving her daughter independence and opportunity to grow.
sentences.zh: 索尼娅在支持卡莉的同时，也给了女儿独立和成长的空间。

sentences.en: Mistakes were inevitable, but they were just lessons learnt.
sentences.zh: 犯错在所难免，但那只是吸取教训的过程。

sentences.en: Whatever came their way, the pair knew they would always have each other.
sentences.zh: 无论发生什么，母女俩都知道她们永远拥有彼此。

sentences.en: Fourteen-year-old Carly Ryan lived with her mother and younger brother in Stirling, a quiet and picturesque hinterland town in South Australia.
sentences.zh: 14岁的卡莉·瑞安与母亲和弟弟住在斯特灵，这是南澳大利亚州一个安静而风景如画的内陆小镇。

sentences.en: Nestled on the southern edge of Mount Lofty, Stirling is the gateway to the sprawling Adelaide Hills wine region.
sentences.zh: 斯特灵坐落在洛夫蒂山脉的南缘，是通往广阔的阿德莱德山葡萄酒产区的门户。

sentences.en: It's known for its scenic main street, organic cafes, historic pub, and stately old homes, alongside striking contemporary architecture.
sentences.zh: 这里以风景优美的主街、有机咖啡馆、历史悠久的酒吧、庄严的古宅以及引人注目的现代建筑而闻名。

sentences.en: Yet, for all its charm, Carly's hometown didn't offer much excitement for a teenager.
sentences.zh: 然而，尽管魅力十足，卡莉的家乡对一个青少年来说并没有太多乐趣。

sentences.en: The population peaked at around 2,500 people, and visitors only really stopped by during autumn to check out the rich colours of the tree-lined main street.
sentences.zh: 这里的人口峰值约为2500人，游客通常只在秋天停留，欣赏绿树成荫的主街上那浓郁的色彩。

sentences.en: There were no cinemas, shopping malls, or music venues, and by nightfall, most of the shops, cafes, and restaurants were closed.
sentences.zh: 这里没有电影院、购物中心或音乐场所，入夜后，大多数商店、咖啡馆和餐馆都关门了。

sentences.en: With Adelaide's city centre a 16-kilometre bus ride away,
sentences.zh: 由于距离阿德莱德市中心有16公里的车程，

sentences.en: Stirling's youth were often left to make their own fun.
sentences.zh: 斯特灵的年轻人往往只能自己找乐子。

sentences.en: It was mostly her interest in the music and fashion that drew Carly to the emo subculture that was flourishing at the time.
sentences.zh: 卡莉对音乐和时尚的兴趣，使她被当时流行的“情绪摇滚”（emo）亚文化所吸引。

sentences.en: The punk-inspired subgroup was often associated with dark colours and themes.
sentences.zh: 这个受朋克启发的亚文化群体通常与深色调和阴郁的主题联系在一起。

sentences.en: However, Carly fully embraced a spectrum of colour in her fashion, a reflection of her bright, creative, and playful nature.
sentences.zh: 然而，卡莉在时尚方面完全拥抱了色彩，这反映了她开朗、富有创造力和俏皮的性格。

sentences.en: She wore pinks, greens, and blues in a variety of patterns, layered with jewellery and band t-shirts.
sentences.zh: 她穿着各种图案的粉色、绿色和蓝色衣服，搭配着首饰和乐队T恤。

sentences.en: She dyed the front part of her fringe red, teased up the back, and framed her eyes with eyeliner.
sentences.zh: 她把刘海的前部染成红色，把后部梳得蓬松，并用眼线勾勒出双眼。

sentences.en: Personality-wise, Carly was far from the brooding and angsty type often associated with the emo scene.
sentences.zh: 在性格上，卡莉远非emo圈子中常见的忧郁和愤世嫉俗的类型。

sentences.en: She was a fun-loving young girl who would go out of her way to make others around her smile.
sentences.zh: 她是一个热爱生活的女孩，总是会想方设法让周围的人开心。

sentences.en: Compassionate and caring, Carly was always looking out for her friends, asking her mother for advice by saying,
sentences.zh: 卡莉富有同情心且乐于助人，她总是关心朋友，并会这样向母亲寻求建议：

sentences.en: I'm worried about my friend.
sentences.zh: “我很担心我的朋友。”

sentences.en: What can I do?
sentences.zh: “我能做些什么呢？”

sentences.en: She'd often tell her mum to take a break from housework, just so the two could put on some music and dance around together.
sentences.zh: 她经常让妈妈放下家务活，只为了两人能一起放点音乐，跳跳舞。

sentences.en: Sonia was only in her early thirties, affording her a genuine sense of relatability to her teenage daughter.
sentences.zh: 索尼娅才三十出头，这让她与十几岁的女儿之间有着真正的共鸣。

sentences.en: By 2006, the internet was branching out from its infancy into a sprawling, seemingly endless place of entertainment, knowledge, and experiences.
sentences.zh: 到了2006年，互联网正从萌芽阶段扩展为一个庞大且看似无尽的娱乐、知识和体验空间。

sentences.en: Although the internet had a long way to go to become the fully accessible and influential resource it is today, it was fast becoming a staple on many home computers.
sentences.zh: 虽然互联网距离成为今天这种完全普及且极具影响力的资源还有很长的路要走，但它正迅速成为许多家庭电脑上的必备品。

sentences.en: The seeds of online powerhouses and social media hangouts,
sentences.zh: 在线巨头和社交媒体平台的种子，

sentences.en: Facebook, YouTube, Reddit, and Twitter, were planted by 2006, but had yet to evolve.
sentences.zh: 如Facebook、YouTube、Reddit和Twitter，在2006年时已经种下，但尚未完全演变。

sentences.en: At the time, MySpace was the biggest social media platform in the world, surpassing even Google that year as the most visited website.
sentences.zh: 当时，MySpace是全球最大的社交媒体平台，那一年的访问量甚至超过了谷歌。

sentences.en: The site offered users a platform to submit blogs, photos, music, and videos on personalised profiles shared to their network of friends.
sentences.zh: 该网站为用户提供了一个平台，可以在分享给好友网络的个性化个人资料上发布博客、照片、音乐和视频。

sentences.en: It quickly drew in a younger generation looking to make connections far beyond the borders of their hometowns.
sentences.zh: 它迅速吸引了年轻一代，他们渴望建立超越家乡边界的联系。

sentences.en: There was still a lot yet to learn about the internet and what lurked within it, but users approached it with naive optimism, as did the older generations,
sentences.zh: 人们对互联网及其潜伏的内容还有很多需要了解的地方，但用户和老一辈人一样，都带着天真的乐观态度去接触它，

sentences.en: who were coming to grasp this unquantifiable thing that seemed like the work of science fiction.
sentences.zh: 他们正开始理解这种似乎只有科幻小说里才会出现的、难以量化的事物。

sentences.en: Like her peers,
sentences.zh: 和同龄人一样，

sentences.en: Carly Ryan found herself drawn to spending time online, where there was always something to do or someone to talk to.
sentences.zh: 卡莉·瑞安发现自己沉迷于上网，那里总是有事可做，有人可聊。

sentences.en: Sitting at the family computer in the kitchen of her home,
sentences.zh: 坐在家里厨房的电脑前，

sentences.en: Carly scrolled through forums dedicated to her interests, chatted with friends through MSN Messenger, and posted selfies taken with her digital camera.
sentences.zh: 卡莉浏览着专门讨论她兴趣的论坛，通过MSN Messenger与朋友聊天，并发布用数码相机拍摄的自拍照。

sentences.en: Sonia would often look over her daughter's shoulder as Carly spent countless hours pursuing her favourite sites and exchanging messages back and forth with friends.
sentences.zh: 索尼娅经常站在女儿身后，看着卡莉花无数个小时浏览她最喜欢的网站，并与朋友们来回交换信息。

sentences.en: For Sonia, knowing Carly was just in the other room tapping away on the keyboard came with a sense of relief.
sentences.zh: 对索尼娅来说，知道卡莉就在隔壁房间敲击键盘，让她感到一种宽慰。

sentences.en: Stranger danger was associated with the outside world, where it was visible, brash, and sudden.
sentences.zh: “陌生人危险”通常与外部世界联系在一起，在那里它是可见的、鲁莽且突如其来的。

sentences.en: The online world seemed the safer option, where threats could easily disappear at the press of an off button.
sentences.zh: 在线世界似乎是一个更安全的选择，威胁可以轻易地通过按下关闭按钮而消失。

sentences.en: Carly spent a lot of time on her MySpace page, a digital art space she covered in photos of herself, lyrics from her favourite songs, and to art that resonated with her.
sentences.zh: 卡莉花了很多时间在她的MySpace页面上，这是一个数字艺术空间，她用自己的照片、最喜欢的歌词以及引起她共鸣的艺术作品装饰着这里。

sentences.en: It was online where Carly's friends introduced her to a user going by the name of Corrupt Koala.
sentences.zh: 正是在网上，卡莉的朋友们把她介绍给了一个名叫“腐败考拉”（Corrupt Koala）的用户。

sentences.en: Corrupt Koala had been chatting with mutual friends of Carly and they had come to know him well.
sentences.zh: “腐败考拉”一直与卡莉的共同好友聊天，他们已经很了解他了。

sentences.en: He was 18-year-old Brandon Kane, a born and raised Texan who now lived in South Australia's neighbouring state,
sentences.zh: 他就是18岁的布兰登·凯恩，一个土生土长的德克萨斯人，现在住在南澳大利亚州的邻州，

sentences.en: Victoria.
sentences.zh: 维多利亚州。

sentences.en: Carly was quick to learn she had a lot in common with Brandon.
sentences.zh: 卡莉很快发现她和布兰登有很多共同点。

sentences.en: The pair bonded over similar interests including their mutual love for music.
sentences.zh: 两人因相似的兴趣而结缘，包括对音乐的共同热爱。

sentences.en: Brandon was a musician himself and played the guitar.
sentences.zh: 布兰登本人也是一名音乐人，会弹吉他。

sentences.en: He carried himself as a bit of a rebel, but with a soft emotional edge, just like the musicians Carly admired.
sentences.zh: 他表现得有点叛逆，但又带着一丝温柔的情感，就像卡莉崇拜的那些音乐人一样。

sentences.en: She was fascinated by his American background and how he talked of travelling between his two homes,
sentences.zh: 她对他的美国背景以及他谈论往返于两个家之间的经历感到着迷，

sentences.en: Australia and the USA.
sentences.zh: 即澳大利亚和美国。

sentences.en: Brandon was older, more mature, and well-travelled, offering Carly advice and support.
sentences.zh: 布兰登比她年长，更成熟，去过很多地方，能为卡莉提供建议和支持。

sentences.en: When he remarked that she was cute,
sentences.zh: 当他夸她可爱时，

sentences.en: Carly was giddy.
sentences.zh: 卡莉感到一阵眩晕。

sentences.en: Over the following months,
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几个月里，

sentences.en: Brandon became omnipresent in Carly's entire life, not just her online one.
sentences.zh: 布兰登在卡莉的生活中变得无处不在，不仅仅是在网络生活中。

sentences.en: They exchanged email addresses, instant messenger accounts, phone numbers, and were chatting every single day.
sentences.zh: 他们交换了电子邮件地址、即时通讯账号、电话号码，每天都在聊天。

sentences.en: In the days before smartphones, video calls weren't commonplace, but Brandon sent Carly webcam footage of him on the computer whilst the two messaged each other.
sentences.zh: 在智能手机普及之前的日子里，视频通话并不常见，但布兰登在两人发消息时，会给卡莉发送他在电脑前的网络摄像头录像。

sentences.en: It was as close as possible to seeing him in the flesh.
sentences.zh: 这已经尽可能地接近见到真人了。

sentences.en: For Sonia, hearing about the young musician Carly befriended online didn't immediately alarm her, but she did find her daughter's sudden infatuation of him strange.
sentences.zh: 对于索尼娅来说，听到卡莉在网上结识了一位年轻音乐人的消息并没有让她立即警觉，但她确实觉得女儿对他突然的迷恋很奇怪。

sentences.en: Sonia glimpsed the images and footage
sentences.zh: 索尼娅瞥了一眼布兰登分享的

sentences.en: Brandon was sharing of himself.
sentences.zh: 关于他自己的照片和录像。

sentences.en: There he was, tapping away at his computer keyboard, a young man exactly as Carly described.
sentences.zh: 画面里，他正敲击着电脑键盘，确实是一个像卡莉描述的那样的年轻人。

sentences.en: Sonia's apprehension subsided, but she used her own MySpace profile to keep an eye on the pair.
sentences.zh: 索尼娅的忧虑平息了，但她还是用自己的MySpace个人资料来留意两人的动态。

sentences.en: One of Carly's closest friends had recently started a relationship with a boy she'd originally met online.
sentences.zh: 卡莉的一位密友最近刚开始与一个她在网上认识的男孩交往。

sentences.en: Carly witnessed the couple together, admiring the joy and happiness the pair emanated.
sentences.zh: 卡莉亲眼目睹了这对情侣在一起的样子，羡慕他们散发出的快乐和幸福。

sentences.en: Seeing an online relationship work out in the real world and wanting the same thing for herself,
sentences.zh: 看到一段网恋在现实世界中修成正果，并且自己也渴望同样的东西，

sentences.en: Carly embarked upon an online romantic relationship with Brandon.
sentences.zh: 卡莉便与布兰登开始了网恋。

sentences.en: Brandon was equally eager to be Carly's boyfriend.
sentences.zh: 布兰登也同样渴望成为卡莉的男朋友。

sentences.en: Not wanting to stand in the way of Carly's happiness,
sentences.zh: 不想阻碍卡莉的幸福，

sentences.en: Sonia accepted the relationship.
sentences.zh: 索尼娅接受了这段关系。

sentences.en: She felt her teenage daughter was looking for confidence and validation and found it in the sweeping thrill of her first romance.
sentences.zh: 她觉得十几岁的女儿是在寻找自信和认可，并在初恋的强烈悸动中找到了这些。

sentences.en: The young couple were in constant contact, expressing their love for one another.
sentences.zh: 这对年轻情侣保持着持续的联系，表达着对彼此的爱意。

sentences.en: Eventually, they started to make plans for the future together.
sentences.zh: 最终，他们开始共同规划未来。

sentences.en: Carly's face lit up whenever she spoke of Brandon to friends, and he became accepted as a part of her life.
sentences.zh: 每当卡莉向朋友提起布兰登时，她的脸庞就会发光，他也被大家接受为她生活的一部分。

sentences.en: Their online social media pages were covered in affectionate messages to each other.
sentences.zh: 他们的社交媒体页面上写满了给彼此的深情留言。

sentences.en: All that remained was for them to finally meet in person.
sentences.zh: 剩下的就是他们最终见面了。

sentences.en: It was something Carly was incredibly eager to do, but Brandon lived an eight-hour drive away in a different state, making plans to do so difficult.
sentences.zh: 这是卡莉非常渴望做的事情，但布兰登住在八小时车程外的另一个州，这使得见面计划很难实现。

sentences.en: By late January 2007,
sentences.zh: 到了2007年1月底，

sentences.en: Carly and Brandon had been in contact for 18 months.
sentences.zh: 卡莉和布兰登已经联系了18个月。

sentences.en: With her 15th birthday coming up,
sentences.zh: 随着她15岁生日的临近，

sentences.en: Carly saw the opportunity of meeting Brandon in person as the best gift she could ask for.
sentences.zh: 卡莉认为亲自见到布兰登是她能要求的最好的礼物。

sentences.en: She invited Brandon to her upcoming birthday party, occurring at her family home in Stirling.
sentences.zh: 她邀请布兰登参加她即将在斯特灵家中举行的生日派对。

sentences.en: However, Brandon was quick to shut down her proposal, revealing he was going to be in the United States at the time, and thus unable to attend.
sentences.zh: 然而，布兰登很快拒绝了她的提议，透露他当时要去美国，因此无法参加。

sentences.en: Carly was clearly upset.
sentences.zh: 卡莉显然很失望。

sentences.en: Coincidentally, Brandon explained his father Shane would be driving through Adelaide for work at the time of Carly's party.
sentences.zh: 巧合的是，布兰登解释说他的父亲肖恩正好会在卡莉派对期间开车经过阿德莱德出差。

sentences.en: Brandon asked if his father could stop by her place and deliver birthday gifts on his behalf.
sentences.zh: 布兰登问他的父亲是否可以顺道去她家，代他送上生日礼物。

sentences.en: Previously, Brandon had introduced his father Shane to Carly through MySpace.
sentences.zh: 此前，布兰登已经通过MySpace把他的父亲肖恩介绍给了卡莉。

sentences.en: Shane was a former SAS commando who now worked as a security guard for celebrities.
sentences.zh: 肖恩曾是一名特种空勤团（SAS）突击队员，现在为名人担任保镖。

sentences.en: He'd once told Carly about his experiences working for goth rock musician Marilyn Manson, and being a fan, she was impressed.
sentences.zh: 他曾告诉卡莉他为哥特摇滚音乐人玛丽莲·曼森工作的经历，作为粉丝，她印象深刻。

sentences.en: Carly was happy to interact with Shane and build a relationship with him.
sentences.zh: 卡莉很高兴能与肖恩互动并建立关系。

sentences.en: Being close to Brandon's family made Carly feel a part of his life.
sentences.zh: 与布兰登的家人亲近让卡莉感觉自己成了他生活的一部分。

sentences.en: Shane was supportive of the young couple and seemed to have their best interests at heart.
sentences.zh: 肖恩支持这对年轻情侣，看起来也是真心为他们着想。

sentences.en: When Carly asked her mother if Shane could attend her birthday party,
sentences.zh: 当卡莉问母亲肖恩是否可以参加她的生日派对时，

sentences.en: Sonia was unsure.
sentences.zh: 索尼娅拿不定主意。

sentences.en: Motherly instincts kicked in.
sentences.zh: 母亲的直觉开始发挥作用。

sentences.en: She didn't know Shane well and was hesitant for a man she considered a little more than a stranger to come to her house.
sentences.zh: 她不太了解肖恩，对于让一个她认为几乎是陌生人的男人来家里感到犹豫。

sentences.en: Carly told Sonia everything she knew about Shane, assuring her mother he was a good guy.
sentences.zh: 卡莉告诉了索尼娅她所知道的关于肖恩的一切，向母亲保证他是个好人。

sentences.en: Adding to his genuineness was Shane's work as a security guard to celebrities, a role that would only be given to someone trustworthy.
sentences.zh: 肖恩作为名人保镖的工作也增加了他的真实性，因为这个职位只会交给值得信赖的人。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, Sonia could hear the faint sound of alarm bells ringing in the back of her mind.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，索尼娅还是能听到内心深处隐约响起的警钟。

sentences.en: She considered out loud if Shane was a predator.
sentences.zh: 她甚至大声怀疑肖恩是否是个掠夺者。

sentences.en: Carly quickly disregarded the suggestion, telling her mother she was being gross.
sentences.zh: 卡莉很快反驳了这个想法，告诉母亲她太恶心了。

sentences.en: After impassioned begging from her daughter,
sentences.zh: 在女儿苦苦哀求之后，

sentences.en: Sonia permitted Shane to come to the party, on one condition.
sentences.zh: 索尼娅允许肖恩参加派对，但有一个条件。

sentences.en: He would have to meet Sonia in a public place firSt.
sentences.zh: 他必须先在公共场合与索尼娅见面。

sentences.en: It seemed like the safest option.
sentences.zh: 这似乎是最安全的选择。

sentences.en: She wanted to get a better feel for the guy before letting him near her family.
sentences.zh: 她想在让他靠近家人之前，先对他有个更好的了解。

sentences.en: Shane happily agreed to the meet-up.
sentences.zh: 肖恩愉快地同意了这次会面。

sentences.en: In the days leading up to the party,
sentences.zh: 在派对前的几天里，

sentences.en: Sonia met Shane on the main street of Stirling.
sentences.zh: 索尼娅在斯特灵的主街上见到了肖恩。

sentences.en: He was a fairly unremarkable man in his late 40s, with slightly balding hair, a beer belly, crooked teeth, and hunched shoulders.
sentences.zh: 他是一个40多岁、相貌平平的男人，头发有些秃顶，挺着啤酒肚，牙齿歪斜，肩膀佝偻。

sentences.en: He explained he was in the area for work, a statement backed up by the polo shirt he wore that bore the logo of his security company.
sentences.zh: 他解释说他在附近出差，他身上穿着印有保安公司标志的Polo衫，证明了他的说法。

sentences.en: He was doing Brandon a favour of delivering birthday gifts to Carly, but thought it was a good idea that he finally meet the family of his son's affection.
sentences.zh: 他是在帮布兰登给卡莉送生日礼物，但也觉得能见见儿子心仪对象的家人是个好主意。

sentences.en: Sonia asked to see some form of identification.
sentences.zh: 索尼娅要求查看某种身份证明。

sentences.en: Shane gladly handed over his security badge, confirming his name, address, and occupation.
sentences.zh: 肖恩欣然交出了他的保安证，确认了他的姓名、地址和职业。

sentences.en: Any doubt Sonia had about the man was quickly overshadowed by authentic evidence proving he was everything he claimed to be.
sentences.zh: 索尼娅对这个男人的任何怀疑，很快就被证明他所言非虚的真实证据所掩盖。

sentences.en: She felt he was friendly enough, and Shane was happy to oblige to Sonia's request to calm all her concerns about him.
sentences.zh: 她觉得他足够友好，而且肖恩很乐意配合索尼娅的要求，以消除她对他所有的顾虑。

sentences.en: As Shane didn't have a hotel booking,
sentences.zh: 由于肖恩没有预订酒店，

sentences.en: Sonia graciously invited him to stay at her place for the duration of his trip.
sentences.zh: 索尼娅大方地邀请他在行程期间住在自己家里。

sentences.en: It only seemed right, considering their children were dating.
sentences.zh: 考虑到他们的孩子正在约会，这似乎很合情合理。

sentences.en: When Shane met other members of the Ryan family, he got along fine with everyone.
sentences.zh: 当肖恩见到瑞安家的其他成员时，他与每个人都相处得很好。

sentences.en: Carly was most excited to meet him, as she was his direct connection to Brandon.
sentences.zh: 卡莉最兴奋见到他，因为他是她与布兰登之间的直接联系人。

sentences.en: He handed over the birthday gifts his son had gotten for her.
sentences.zh: 他交出了儿子为她准备的生日礼物。

sentences.en: She opened them later, discovering Brandon had purchased her lingerie and a nurse's outfit.
sentences.zh: 她后来拆开了礼物，发现布兰登给她买了内衣和护士装。

sentences.en: They weren't items Carly had asked for, but she was happy to receive them, as Brandon wanted her to have them.
sentences.zh: 这些并不是卡莉要求的物品，但她很高兴能收到，因为布兰登希望她拥有这些。

sentences.en: It appeared Shane was eager to make a good impression on Carly on Brandon's behalf.
sentences.zh: 看来肖恩很急于代表布兰登给卡莉留下好印象。

sentences.en: In the days leading up to the party, he took her shopping at Rundle Mall in Adelaide City, sharing her with over $400 worth of gifts, including t-shirts, bags, underwear,
sentences.zh: 在派对前的几天里，他带她去阿德莱德市的朗德尔购物中心购物，给她买了价值超过400美元的礼物，包括T恤、包、内衣，

sentences.en: a corset, and fancy dress costumes.
sentences.zh: 一件紧身胸衣和几套化装舞会服装。

sentences.en: Anything Carly wanted,
sentences.zh: 任何卡莉想要的，

sentences.en: Shane would get for her.
sentences.zh: 肖恩都会给她买。

sentences.en: At one clothing store, a shop assistant suggested Carly go try on some clothing she was eyeing.
sentences.zh: 在一家服装店，店员建议卡莉去试穿几件她看中的衣服。

sentences.en: Shane followed Carly to the change room, and the shop assistant witnessed him peering over the door, watching Carly inside.
sentences.zh: 肖恩跟着卡莉去了试衣间，店员目睹他从门上方探头窥视，盯着里面的卡莉。

sentences.en: The assistant thought it was weird, but Carly didn't seem outwardly phased by the action.
sentences.zh: 店员觉得这很奇怪，但卡莉看起来并没有被这一举动吓到。

sentences.en: On the night of January 26, 2007,
Shane joined Carly's friends and family members in celebrating her 15th birthday at her home.
sentences.zh: 肖恩和卡莉的亲友一起在她家庆祝她的15岁生日。

sentences.en: Everything started off smoothly, and Carly and her guests were having a great time.
sentences.zh: 一切开始得很顺利，卡莉和客人们玩得很开心。

sentences.en: But as the night wore on,
sentences.zh: 但随着夜色渐深，

sentences.en: Shane started exhibiting noticeably strange behaviour.
sentences.zh: 肖恩开始表现出明显的怪异行为。

sentences.en: At one point, Carly was talking to an old friend who happened to be her ex-boyfriend.
sentences.zh: 有一次，卡莉正在和一位碰巧是她前男友的老朋友聊天。

sentences.en: When Shane found out, he got visibly agitated and behaved in a way others could only describe as a tantrum.
sentences.zh: 当肖恩发现后，他明显变得焦躁不安，其行为只能被旁人形容为发脾气。

sentences.en: He later informed Carly he called and spoke to Brandon on the phone about her behaviour.
sentences.zh: 他后来告诉卡莉，他已经打电话给布兰登，谈论了她的行为。

sentences.en: Brandon expressed that he wasn't happy
sentences.zh: 布兰登表示他很不高兴

sentences.en: Carly was talking to her ex.
sentences.zh: 卡莉和她的前任交谈。

sentences.en: Shane warned her to stay away from him, and Carly, wanting to keep her boyfriend happy, agreed to the demand.
sentences.zh: 肖恩警告她离那个人远点，而卡莉为了让男友高兴，答应了这个要求。

sentences.en: Shane's behaviour towards other guests also became increasingly inappropriate.
sentences.zh: 肖恩对其他客人的行为也变得越来越不得体。

sentences.en: He made other teenage girls uncomfortable when encouraging them to kiss each other in front of him, even demanding Carly kiss one of her friends,
sentences.zh: 他怂恿其他十几岁的女孩在他面前亲吻，让她们感到不适，甚至要求卡莉亲吻她的一个朋友，

sentences.en: causing the girls to label him as creepy.
sentences.zh: 导致女孩们称他为变态。

sentences.en: Another party-goer overheard Shane tell Carly, I love you.
sentences.zh: 另一位参加派对的人无意中听到肖恩对卡莉说：“我爱你。”

sentences.en: I would never let anything happen to you.
sentences.zh: “我绝不会让你受到任何伤害。”

sentences.en: You're beautiful.
sentences.zh: “你真美。”

sentences.en: Motivated to maintain a good relationship with the man she saw as her future father-in-law,
sentences.zh: 为了维持与她眼中未来公公的关系，

sentences.en: Carly appeared to brush away any concerns she or others felt about Shane.
sentences.zh: 卡莉似乎掩盖了她或其他人对肖恩的任何担忧。

sentences.en: Armed with mother's intuition,
sentences.zh: 凭借母亲的直觉，

sentences.en: Sonia still had her doubts.
sentences.zh: 索尼娅仍然心存疑虑。

sentences.en: Shane had been around for a few days now, and despite accepting the man into her home, she felt herself constantly on guard.
sentences.zh: 肖恩已经在家里待了几天了，尽管她接受了这个男人住进家里，但她感到自己时刻保持着警惕。

sentences.en: She tolerated him, but with great caution.
sentences.zh: 她容忍了他，但非常谨慎。

sentences.en: She was willing to give him the benefit of the doubt to make Carly happy and keep the peace, but never felt she could fully trust him.
sentences.zh: 为了让卡莉高兴并维持和平，她愿意给予他信任，但她从未觉得能完全相信他。

sentences.en: The morning after the party,
sentences.zh: 派对后的第二天早上，

sentences.en: Sonia walked past her daughter's bedroom.
sentences.zh: 索尼娅经过女儿的卧室。

sentences.en: She peered inside to check on Carly, and was horrified to discover Shane was laying on her daughter's bed beside her.
sentences.zh: 她往里看去想查看卡莉的情况，却惊恐地发现肖恩正躺在女儿身边的床上。

sentences.en: They appeared asleep, and although he was fully clothed and lying on top of the sheets, the scene was enough to deeply disturb Sonia.
sentences.zh: 他们似乎睡着了，虽然他穿着衣服且躺在被子上面，但这一幕足以让索尼娅深感不安。

sentences.en: There was absolutely no excuse for it.
sentences.zh: 这绝对没有任何借口。

sentences.en: The man had crossed the boundary.
sentences.zh: 这个男人越界了。

sentences.en: All of Shane's peculiarities flashed through Sonia's mind, now with sinister undertones, like the way his gaze lingered on her teenage daughter whenever they were together.
sentences.zh: 肖恩所有的怪异之处在索尼娅脑海中闪过，现在带上了邪恶的意味，比如每当他们在一起时，他盯着她十几岁女儿的那种眼神。

sentences.en: It was enough to make Sonia's skin crawl.
sentences.zh: 这足以让索尼娅毛骨悚然。

sentences.en: She was convinced.
sentences.zh: 她确信了。

sentences.en: Shane was a predator.
sentences.zh: 肖恩是个掠食者。

sentences.en: Enraged, Sonia demanded Shane leave her house, telling him he was no longer welcome and he was no longer to have any contact with Carly.
sentences.zh: 索尼娅怒不可遏，要求肖恩离开她家，告诉他这里不再欢迎他，也不准再与卡莉有任何联系。

sentences.en: Shane puffed up and got aggressive, defending himself against what Sonia was implying.
sentences.zh: 肖恩气势汹汹地变得咄咄逼人，为自己辩解，反驳索尼娅的暗示。

sentences.en: He stormed through the house and grabbed his bag, leaving quickly in anger.
sentences.zh: 他冲过屋子抓起包，愤怒地匆匆离开。

sentences.en: Carly was incredibly upset by the events unfolding, crying and begging her mum to reconsider.
sentences.zh: 卡莉对发生的一切感到非常难过，哭着求母亲重新考虑。

sentences.en: She cared so passionately about Brandon and worried the fight between their parents would jeopardise their relationship.
sentences.zh: 她非常在乎布兰登，担心父母之间的争吵会危及他们的关系。

sentences.en: Sonia told her daughter firmly,
sentences.zh: 索尼娅坚定地告诉女儿：

sentences.en: Carly, something isn't right about this.
sentences.zh: “卡莉，这件事不对劲。”

sentences.en: Something doesn't feel right.
sentences.zh: “感觉有些不对劲。”

sentences.en: At that moment, something seemed to click in Carly's mind.
sentences.zh: 那一刻，卡莉脑海中似乎有什么东西被点通了。

sentences.en: She sat down at the kitchen table, looked at her mother and said,
sentences.zh: 她坐在厨房桌旁，看着母亲说：

sentences.en: Okay, mum.
sentences.zh: “好吧，妈妈。”

sentences.en: After things had calmed down,
sentences.zh: 在事情平息之后，

sentences.en: Carly broke down and confided in her mum, revealing Shane had unbuckled her pants, lifted her top and touched her inappropriately.
sentences.zh: 卡莉崩溃了并向母亲吐露心声，透露肖恩解开了她的裤子，掀起她的上衣，并对她进行了不当触摸。

sentences.en: He had also propositioned her for sex, explaining that Brandon wouldn't mind if they did it.
sentences.zh: 他还向她提出性要求，解释说如果他们做了，布兰登也不会介意。

sentences.en: Carly accepted the man was a creep, but wanted Sonia to talk things through with him, to quash any conflict, for hers and Brandon's sake.
sentences.zh: 卡莉承认这个男人是个变态，但她希望索尼娅能和他谈谈，为了她和布兰登，平息任何冲突。

sentences.en: But the news of Shane's perversions far outweighed her daughter's teen romance.
sentences.zh: 但肖恩变态行为的消息远比女儿的青春期恋情重要得多。

sentences.en: Sonia just wanted to keep Carly safe and away from Shane.
sentences.zh: 索尼娅只想保护卡莉的安全，让她远离肖恩。

sentences.en: She obtained Shane's email address and sent him a heated message, once again warning him to stay away from her daughter or she would notify police about what he did to Carly.
sentences.zh: 她获得了肖恩的电子邮件地址，并给他发了一条愤怒的信息，再次警告他离她女儿远点，否则她会向警方举报他对卡莉所做的事。

sentences.en: She received a response from Shane's email.
sentences.zh: 她收到了来自肖恩邮箱的回复。

sentences.en: He wrote,
sentences.zh: 他写道：

sentences.en: Bitch, please.
sentences.zh: “少废话。”

sentences.en: That email was so full of lies and hearsay and I am disgusted that someone of a reasonable intelligence could believe such crap to be true.
sentences.zh: “那封邮件充满了谎言和道听途说，我感到恶心，一个有理智的人竟然会相信这种垃圾。”

sentences.en: The things you called me were totally defaming and I have forwarded the email onto my solicitor for further action.
sentences.zh: “你对我的称呼完全是诽谤，我已经把这封邮件转发给我的律师采取进一步行动。”

sentences.en: I sincerely hope you have insurance against lawsuits.
sentences.zh: “我真心希望你买了诉讼保险。”

sentences.en: You will need it.
sentences.zh: “你会用得上的。”

sentences.en: I will go into court as a decorated SAS officer while you will go in as a bitch.
sentences.zh: “我会以一名功勋卓著的SAS军官身份出庭，而你将以一个泼妇的身份出庭。”

sentences.en: Determined to keep Shane from contacting Carly,
sentences.zh: 为了阻止肖恩联系卡莉，

sentences.en: Sonia temporarily confiscated Carly's mobile phone, computer and internet access.
sentences.zh: 索尼娅暂时没收了卡莉的手机、电脑和互联网访问权限。

sentences.en: It worked.
sentences.zh: 这奏效了。

sentences.en: To their relief, they didn't hear from him.
sentences.zh: 令她们欣慰的是，她们没有再收到他的消息。

sentences.en: As far as Sonia knew,
sentences.zh: 据索尼娅所知，

sentences.en: Shane had taken her warning seriously.
sentences.zh: 肖恩认真对待了她的警告。

sentences.en: It was unknown whether or not Brandon was told what his father did to Carly during his stay at the Ryan house.
sentences.zh: 目前尚不清楚布兰登是否被告知了他父亲在瑞安家期间对卡莉做了什么。

sentences.en: Despite the actions of his father,
sentences.zh: 尽管他父亲有此行径，

sentences.en: Carly still had feelings for her boyfriend.
sentences.zh: 卡莉对男友仍有感情。

sentences.en: She still hoped they would someday meet so she could clear things up between them.
sentences.zh: 她仍然希望有一天他们能见面，这样她就能澄清他们之间的事情。

sentences.en: Less than one month later, at midday on February 19, 2007,
sentences.zh: 不到一个月后，2007年2月19日中午，

sentences.en: Carly told her mum she was going to catch a bus into the city to meet up with friends.
sentences.zh: 卡莉告诉母亲她要乘公交车进城去见朋友。

sentences.en: Carly made the trip into Adelaide often to go shopping around the Rundle Moor precinct and hang out with friends in the surrounding parklands.
sentences.zh: 卡莉经常去阿德莱德，在朗德尔购物区逛街，并与朋友在周边的公园里闲逛。

sentences.en: Afterwards, she told her mother she would spend the night at a friend's place.
sentences.zh: 之后，她告诉母亲她要在朋友家过夜。

sentences.en: Carly put on a leopard print dress with a pair of black wedge heels.
sentences.zh: 卡莉穿了一件豹纹连衣裙，配了一双黑色坡跟鞋。

sentences.en: She grabbed her navy blue duffel bag, filling it with necessities for her sleepover.
sentences.zh: 她拿上深蓝色行李袋，装满了过夜必需品。

sentences.en: This included a change of clothes, a can of hairspray, her purse, mobile phone, and a tube of lip balm.
sentences.zh: 其中包括换洗衣服、一罐发胶、钱包、手机和一支润唇膏。

sentences.en: Throughout her preparations, she stopped to give her mum four separate hugs.
sentences.zh: 在准备过程中，她停下来给了母亲四个单独的拥抱。

sentences.en: Sonia noticed her daughter had a funny expression on her face that morning, a look that she didn't recognise.
sentences.zh: 索尼娅注意到那天早上女儿脸上有一种奇怪的表情，一种她从未见过的神情。

sentences.en: Carly wasn't her typical cheerful self.
sentences.zh: 卡莉不再是她平时那个开朗的样子了。

sentences.en: Before she left at about 4pm,
sentences.zh: 下午4点左右她离开前，

sentences.en: Carly rushed over to give her mum one final big hug.
sentences.zh: 卡莉冲过来给了母亲最后一个大大的拥抱。

sentences.en: Her hold was noticeably tight.
sentences.zh: 她抱得明显很紧。

sentences.en: When she did pull away,
sentences.zh: 当她松开手时，

sentences.en: Carly headed to the front door.
sentences.zh: 卡莉走向前门。

sentences.en: As she skipped off the veranda,
sentences.zh: 当她蹦蹦跳跳地离开阳台时，

sentences.en: Carly called out,
sentences.zh: 卡莉喊道：

sentences.en: Love you, Mum.
sentences.zh: “爱你，妈妈。”

sentences.en: The following morning, on February 20, the phone rang at the Ryan household.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，2月20日，瑞安家的电话响了。

sentences.en: Sonia answered.
sentences.zh: 索尼娅接了电话。

sentences.en: The caller explained they had found a purse left on the footpath of a southern suburb of Adelaide.
sentences.zh: 来电者解释说，他们在阿德莱德南部郊区的人行道上发现了一个钱包。

sentences.en: Assuming it was a piece of lost property, they looked inside for a form of ID and found a phone number, which rang through to Sonia Ryan.

sentences.zh: 她声称，纽曼的真实面目被他的家人、朋友、警察、医生、医院工作人员和法院所忽视。

sentences.en: Newman subsequently appealed his conviction on several grounds.
sentences.zh: 纽曼随后以多项理由对判决提出上诉。

sentences.en: One of those claimed Sonia Ryan should not have been allowed to give evidence at trial, as he believed conversations she had with Carly were
sentences.zh: 其中一项声称不应允许索尼娅·瑞安在审判中作证，因为他认为她与卡莉的谈话属于

sentences.en: hearsay, including the one where Carly revealed she had been inappropriately touched.
sentences.zh: 传闻证据，包括卡莉透露自己曾被不当触摸的那一次。

sentences.en: In April 2011, his appeal was rejected.
sentences.zh: 2011年4月，他的上诉被驳回。

sentences.en: Judges believed it was important the jury be provided with context about events leading up to the murder, and evidence that Newman intended to
sentences.zh: 法官认为，让陪审团了解谋杀案发生前的背景事件非常重要，而且即便没有

sentences.en: kill Carly was still overwhelming without
sentences.zh: 索尼娅·瑞安的证词，纽曼意图

sentences.en: Sonia Ryan's testimony.
sentences.zh: 杀害卡莉的证据依然确凿无疑。

sentences.en: Carly Ryan was the first Australian to be murdered by an online predator.
sentences.zh: 卡莉·瑞安是澳大利亚第一位被网络掠夺者杀害的受害者。

sentences.en: A day doesn't pass without Sonia thinking of her daughter.
sentences.zh: 索尼娅没有一天不在想念她的女儿。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引用：

sentences.en: You can imagine from a mother's perspective.
sentences.zh: 你可以从一位母亲的角度想象一下。

sentences.en: I asked myself constantly, how couldn't I see that she was in so much danger?
sentences.zh: 我不断地问自己，我怎么会没看出她正处于如此巨大的危险之中？

sentences.en: The amount of depravity and controlling, the length she went through to get hold of her.
sentences.zh: 那种堕落和控制欲，他为了抓住她所费尽的心机。

sentences.en: I was no match for that.
sentences.zh: 我根本无法与之抗衡。

sentences.en: He used her best qualities to lure her to her death.
sentences.zh: 他利用她身上最美好的品质，将她诱向死亡。

sentences.en: The murder of her daughter left Sonia shattered.
sentences.zh: 女儿的遇害让索尼娅彻底崩溃。

sentences.en: Since her birth, Carly had given Sonia reason to live.
sentences.zh: 自出生以来，卡莉就是索尼娅活下去的理由。

sentences.en: Now that she was gone, Sonia struggled to go on.
sentences.zh: 现在她走了，索尼娅在艰难地支撑着活下去。

sentences.en: Sonia Ryan, quote,
sentences.zh: 索尼娅·瑞安，引用：

sentences.en: When everything happened to Carly, it was like being pulled into some kind of black abyss that
sentences.zh: 当卡莉发生这一切时，感觉就像被拖进了某种黑洞，那是

sentences.en: Gary Newman had created.
sentences.zh: 加里·纽曼制造的黑洞。

sentences.en: I can't sit in that space, because it's sitting in her suffering, and it would just dissolve my soul.
sentences.zh: 我无法坐在那个空间里，因为那是在沉浸于她的痛苦，那会彻底摧毁我的灵魂。

sentences.en: I think what people don't realise is the trauma, and I wouldn't want them to realise.
sentences.zh: 我想人们没有意识到的是那种创伤，我也不希望他们意识到。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, these crimes continue to happen.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，这些罪行仍在不断发生。

sentences.en: Carly suffered terribly at the hands of a monster with no remorse.
sentences.zh: 卡莉在那个毫无悔意的恶魔手中遭受了极其可怕的折磨。

sentences.en: Where does that leave me as her mother?
sentences.zh: 作为她的母亲，我该怎么办？

sentences.en: That leaves me in a position to either die, or find the strength somewhere from within to fight.
sentences.zh: 我只能选择要么死去，要么从内心深处找到战斗的力量。

sentences.en: Fight not only for Carly, but fight for every single young person that is online trying to make connections.
sentences.zh: 不仅是为了卡莉而战，也是为了每一个在网上试图建立联系的年轻人而战。

sentences.en: I believe this is what Carly would want me to do.
sentences.zh: 我相信这就是卡莉希望我做的事。

sentences.en: Determined for her daughter's death not to be in vain,
sentences.zh: 为了不让女儿白白牺牲，

sentences.en: Sonia established the Carly Ryan Foundation, a not-for-profit organisation dedicated to promoting internet safety.
sentences.zh: 索尼娅成立了卡莉·瑞安基金会，这是一个致力于推广互联网安全的非营利组织。

sentences.en: Sonia has worked tirelessly for over a decade, educating schoolchildren, families, and the community about the dangers of online interaction, and providing support,
sentences.zh: 十多年来，索尼娅不知疲倦地工作，向学童、家庭和社区普及网络互动的危险，并提供支持、

sentences.en: counselling, and political advocacy.
sentences.zh: 咨询和政策倡导。

sentences.en: Her efforts earned her the title of 2013
sentences.zh: 她的努力使她获得了2013年

sentences.en: South Australian of the Year.
sentences.zh: 南澳大利亚年度人物的称号。

sentences.en: The internet is an amazing tool for education and communication, but we have to be aware of the dangers it can pose as well.
sentences.zh: 互联网是教育和交流的绝佳工具，但我们也必须意识到它可能带来的危险。

sentences.en: Carly's story reminds us that not everyone online is who they say they are, and that we need to question what we're told, not just accept it and trust it.
sentences.zh: 卡莉的故事提醒我们，网上的人并不一定就是他们所说的那样，我们需要质疑所听到的信息，而不是盲目接受和信任。

sentences.en: In June 2017, after a vigorous crusade at both state and federal level, Carly's law was passed into the Commonwealth Criminal Code by the Australian Government.
sentences.zh: 2017年6月，在州和联邦层面进行了一场强有力的运动后，澳大利亚政府将《卡莉法》纳入了联邦刑法典。

sentences.en: The new law makes it a crime for an adult to use a carriage service to plan, prepare, cause harm to, or engage in sexual activity with a minor.
sentences.zh: 新法律规定，成年人利用通信服务策划、准备、造成伤害或与未成年人进行性活动属于犯罪。

sentences.en: It carries a 10-year maximum prison term for offenders.
sentences.zh: 违法者最高可被判处10年监禁。

sentences.en: The first arrest under Carly's law was made just a few weeks later.
sentences.zh: 《卡莉法》实施后的第一次逮捕发生在几周后。

sentences.en: In May 2018, Carly's law was further strengthened in South Australia.
sentences.zh: 2018年5月，南澳大利亚州进一步加强了《卡莉法》。

sentences.en: A tougher version of the law was passed, making it illegal for a person to lie about their age in an attempt to meet a child, even if they don't intend to commit a crime against
sentences.zh: 一项更严厉的法律版本获得通过，规定即使没有意图对儿童实施犯罪，谎报年龄试图与儿童见面也属于违法行为，

sentences.en: the child.
sentences.zh: 哪怕只是为了接近孩子。

sentences.en: After Carly's law was enacted, a patchwork quilt made from the teenager's favourite clothes was hung up on a wall in Parliament House.
sentences.zh: 《卡莉法》颁布后，一件用这位少女生前最爱衣服缝制的拼布被子被挂在议会大厦的墙上。

sentences.en: Each piece of fabric is in the shape of a heart.
sentences.zh: 每一块布料都被剪成了心形。

sentences.en: A colourful display of reds, greens, blues, pinks and whites, in polka dots, stripes and checkered patterns.
sentences.zh: 这是一幅色彩斑斓的展示，有红色、绿色、蓝色、粉色和白色，图案包括波点、条纹和格子。

sentences.en: At its centre is the largest heart, made from a green fabric with white dots, cut out from what was once Carly's favourite dress.
sentences.zh: 中心是一颗最大的心，由一块带有白点的绿色布料制成，那是从卡莉曾经最喜欢的裙子上剪下来的。

sentences.en: She wore it during a mock wedding she once had with a friend.
sentences.zh: 她曾穿着它与朋友玩过一场模拟婚礼。

sentences.en: After the memorial quilt was unveiled, Sonia Ryan wrote a piece for the advertiser.
sentences.zh: 纪念被子揭幕后，索尼娅·瑞安为《广告人报》写了一篇文章。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引用：

sentences.en: My daughter's favourite pyjamas are hanging in Federal Parliament.
sentences.zh: 我女儿最喜欢的睡衣正挂在联邦议会大厦里。

sentences.en: They're hanging there, in the hallways of power, when really the only hallway they should be hanging in is mine.
sentences.zh: 它们挂在那里，挂在权力的走廊里，而实际上它们唯一应该挂的地方是我的家里。

sentences.en: But that'll never happen now.
sentences.zh: 但那永远不会再发生了。

sentences.en: Aged just 15, my beautiful daughter Carly was murdered by a pedophile who lied about his age online.
sentences.zh: 我美丽的女儿卡莉年仅15岁，就被一个在网上谎报年龄的恋童癖杀害了。

sentences.en: I've fought with every breath in my body for Carly's legacy.
sentences.zh: 我用尽全身的力气为卡莉的遗产而战。

sentences.en: I met with Prime Minister Malcolm Turnbull as his government announced Carly's law.
sentences.zh: 在政府宣布《卡莉法》时，我见到了马尔科姆·特恩布尔总理。

sentences.en: It'll end the loophole leaving kids vulnerable to predators.
sentences.zh: 它将堵住让孩子们容易受到掠夺者伤害的漏洞。

sentences.en: Police will better identify sick, predatory activity online to prevent horrific sex crimes against our kids.
sentences.zh: 警方将能更好地识别网上病态的掠夺性活动，以防止针对我们孩子的可怕性犯罪。

sentences.en: As I write this, sitting in Parliament under my daughter's pyjamas, I feel closer to her than ever.
sentences.zh: 当我写下这些文字，坐在议会大厦里，看着女儿的睡衣时，我感到与她前所未有的亲近。

sentences.en: And also more determined.
sentences.zh: 也更加坚定了信念。

sentences.en: I'd hate any other mother to live through what I've endured.
sentences.zh: 我不希望任何其他母亲经历我所承受的一切。

sentences.en: Carly's death will no longer be in vain.
sentences.zh: 卡莉的死将不再是徒劳的。

sentences.en: Together, we're stopping any other family going through the horrendous pain that mine has.
sentences.zh: 我们齐心协力，正在阻止其他家庭经历我家所遭受的恐怖痛苦。

sentences.en: If you have a daughter, go home and squeeze her tighter than you've ever squeezed her.
sentences.zh: 如果你有女儿，回家后请紧紧地拥抱她，比以往任何时候都要用力。

sentences.en: Tell her you love her over and again.
sentences.zh: 一遍又一遍地告诉她你爱她。

sentences.en: And know that she'll be safer from today thanks to a perfect, compassionate, forever young 15-year-old girl called Carly.
sentences.zh: 并且要知道，从今天起，多亏了一个完美、富有同情心、永远年轻的15岁女孩卡莉，她会变得更加安全。

sentences.en: Further adding to Sonia's grief was knowing Carly had her mobile phone on her prior to her murder, but was unable to find an opportune moment to call or text her for help.
sentences.zh: 让索尼娅更加悲痛的是，她知道卡莉在遇害前身上带着手机，却没能找到合适的机会打电话或发短信求救。

sentences.en: This inspired Sonia to create Thread.
sentences.zh: 这启发了索尼娅创建了“Thread”应用。

sentences.en: Thread is a safety app free to download on mobile phones.
sentences.zh: Thread是一款可以在手机上免费下载的安全应用程序。

sentences.en: If the user feels at all in danger or threatened, they can send a discreet alert that reveals their location to trusted contacts and emergency services.
sentences.zh: 如果用户感到有任何危险或威胁，他们可以发送一个隐蔽的警报，将他们的位置发送给受信任的联系人和紧急服务部门。

sentences.en: It was important to Sonia to provide safer options for children to request help if needed, but not discourage parents from letting their children go out into the world and seek
sentences.zh: 对索尼娅来说，重要的是为孩子们提供更安全的求助方式，但并不阻止家长让孩子走向世界并寻求

sentences.en: independence.
sentences.zh: 独立。

sentences.en: The app is currently only available in Australia, but the Carly Ryan Foundation hoped to get funding to make it available worldwide.
sentences.zh: 该应用程序目前仅在澳大利亚可用，但卡莉·瑞安基金会希望获得资金，使其在全球范围内可用。

sentences.en: The name of the app was inspired by a fable that resonated with Sonia.
sentences.zh: 该应用程序的名字灵感来源于一个让索尼娅产生共鸣的寓言故事。

sentences.en: The story of a daughter wanting to meet her suitor in a dark cave, and a mother who had her worries but didn't want to stop her daughter from independence and discovery.
sentences.zh: 故事讲述了一个女儿想在黑暗的洞穴里见她的追求者，而一位母亲虽然担心，但不想阻止女儿追求独立和探索。

sentences.en: It is the thread pulled from the mother's skirt that keeps them connected, regardless of where the daughter travels.
sentences.zh: 正是从母亲裙子上抽出的那根线，将她们连接在一起，无论女儿走到哪里。

sentences.en: The thread would also bring the daughter safely back to the mother, if she found danger.
sentences.zh: 如果女儿遇到危险，这根线也会将她安全地带回母亲身边。

sentences.en: Hey, have you seen my cat?
sentences.zh: 嘿，你看到我的猫了吗？

sentences.en: Uh, no, sorry.
sentences.zh: 呃，没有，抱歉。

sentences.en: Well, he's at home on my couch.
sentences.zh: 哦，它在家里我的沙发上呢。

sentences.en: Here's a picture of him.
sentences.zh: 这是它的照片。

sentences.en: Handsome, isn't he?
sentences.zh: 很帅吧？

sentences.en: Keep your cat safe at home.
sentences.zh: 请让你的猫安全地待在家里。

sentences.en: They'll live 70% longer on average.
sentences.zh: 它们的平均寿命会延长70%。

sentences.en: Message from RSPCA New South Wales with support from the Environmental TruSt.
sentences.zh: 来自新南威尔士州RSPCA的信息，由环境信托基金支持。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Save Christmas.
sentences.zh: 拯救圣诞节。
